\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{குளிர்சாதனப்} \ta{பெட்டி} (kuḷircātaṉap peṭṭi)}{குளிர்சாதனப் பெட்டி (kuḷircātaṉap peṭṭi)}]{\ta{குளிர்சாதனப்} \ta{பெட்டி} (kuḷircātaṉap peṭṭi) — a refrigerator}

\label{lesson:TA-C182-kulircatanap-petti}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for everything, then the Tamil for thick.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{குளிர்சாதனப்} \ta{பெட்டி}}
\textbf{\ta{குளிர்சாதனப்} \ta{பெட்டி}} — \emph{kuḷircātaṉap peṭṭi} — \textquotedblleft{}a refrigerator\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ta{குளிர்சாதனப்} \ta{பெட்டி}} (\emph{kuḷircātaṉap peṭṭi}) is \textquotedblleft{}the cooling-device box\textquotedblright{}: native \emph{kuḷir}, \textquotedblleft{}cold\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 1834), \emph{cātaṉam}, \textquotedblleft{}device\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{sādhana}, \textquotedblleft{}means, instrument\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 13334), and native \emph{peṭṭi}, \textquotedblleft{}box\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 4388).
\end{cousinweb}
